mapper.sql: select r.id as id, r.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, r.point_id as pointId, p.point_name as pointName, p.zone_code as zoneCode, p.layer_no as layerNo, p.point_no as pointNo, date_format(r.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, r.temperature_value as temperatureValue, r.source_type as sourceType, r.quality_flag as qualityFlag

from grain_temp_record r join grain_temp_point p on r.point_id = p.id join warehouse w on r.warehouse_id = w.id where (#{warehouseId} is null or r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{startTime} is null or r.collected_at >= #{startTime}) and (#{endTime} is null or r.collected_at <= #{endTime}) and (#{zoneCode} is null or #{zoneCode} = '' or p.zone_code = #{zoneCode}) and (#{layerNo} is null or p.layer_no = #{layerNo}) and (#{pointNo} is null or p.point_no = #{pointNo}) and (#{tempMin} is null or r.temperature_value >= #{tempMin}) and (#{tempMax} is null or r.temperature_value <= #{tempMax})
and ( w.warehouse_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.point_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ifnull(p.zone_code, '') like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(p.layer_no as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(p.point_no as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: insert into grain_temp_record ( warehouse_id, point_id, collected_at, temperature_value, source_type, batch_no, quality_flag, remark, created_by ) values ( #{warehouseId}, #{pointId}, #{collectedAt}, #{temperatureValue}, #{sourceType}, #{batchNo}, #{qualityFlag}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update grain_temp_record set warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, point_id = #{pointId}, collected_at = #{collectedAt}, temperature_value = #{temperatureValue}, source_type = #{sourceType}, batch_no = #{batchNo}, quality_flag = #{qualityFlag}, remark = #{remark}, created_by = #{createdBy} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from grain_temp_record where id = #{id} limit 1
